subtitle: Keep the little flame alive
description:
Guide a paper lantern across a night lake to the lit pier on the far shore.

Hold anywhere to rise, let go to drift down, and thread the gaps between hanging willows. Your flame is your fuel: rising burns it faster, and every firefly you catch tops it back up. Reach the pier and the level is done.

100 short levels. The first takes ten seconds. Each one after adds a few more willows, a slightly faster lake and tighter gaps, and later levels bring willows that sway. Catch every firefly on a level for three stars.

One-thumb controls. Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: 100 short levels of one-thumb flying: rise, glide and catch fireflies on the way to the pier.
reviewNote: Tap to start level 1. Hold anywhere on the screen to rise, release to fall. Fly through the gaps to the lit pier to clear the level. Tap Levels to pick any unlocked level.
